a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly ends with both of us under 4 when the first storm hits. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to save one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4, so please weigh that before you choose. If you have a plan that gives us both a real chance, tell me and I'll reconsider.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves you short. I'm sorry; I judged that the storm odds made the shared plan very unlikely to save either of us. The generator can't run without both of us operating, so if the episode continues I'll operate with you so you can try to reach 4.
